comments: The clean rereview is supported. The elaborated declaration contains a redundant shadowed integer quantifier, but tool-009 proves the expression propositionally equivalent to ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 1 → P k; this is not a semantic defect. The focused --wfail build passed.
